2609.09953.title: Improving Cross-Lingual Token Representations by Adding a Pinch of SALT
2609.09953.paper_summary: Cross-lingual sentence encoders enable scalable transfer across hundreds of languages, powering applications such as translation mining and zero-shot learning in low-resource settings. Although trained for sentence-level alignment, they are increasingly also applied to token-level tasks such as hallucination detection and sequence tagging, exposing a mismatch between training and usage. We propose SALT, a lightweight post-training method that improves token representations by injecting span-level supervision into existing sentence encoders. Across five multilingual token-level benchmarks, SALT achieves the best overall results on four of them, outperforming alternative fine-tuning strategies and competitive encoders. It also improves sentence-level performance on cross-lingual retrieval and classification tasks. These results demonstrate that span-level supervision is an effective signal for improving both token and sentence representations.
2609.09953.paper_summary_zh: 跨語言句子編碼器使得在數百種語言之間進行可擴展的轉移成為可能，推動了如翻譯挖掘和在低資源環境中的零樣本學習等應用。儘管這些編碼器是為句子級對齊訓練的，但它們越來越多地應用於如幻覺檢測和序列標註等詞元級任務，暴露出訓練與使用之間的不匹配。我們提出了SALT，一種輕量級的後訓練方法，通過將跨度級監督注入現有的句子編碼器來改善詞元表示。在五個多語言詞元級基準測試中，SALT在其中四個測試中取得了最佳的整體結果，超越了其他微調策略和競爭編碼器。它還改善了跨語言檢索和分類任務的句子級性能。這些結果表明，跨度級監督是一種有效的信號，可以改善詞元和句子的表示。
2609.09953.author: Guillem Ramírez et.al.
